description: Trace message flow through a production by session ID or header ID. At least one of sessionId or headerId is required. Each message step includes source item, target item, message class, timestamp, and status. Use sessionId to see all messages in a session, or headerId for a specific message.

count.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 100, max: 10000)

headerId.description: Specific message header ID to look up

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to query a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

sessionId.description: Session ID to trace (returns all messages in the session)

name: iris_production_messages
title: Production Messages
